bricks.description: shot on warm colour negative portrait film, soft pastel skin tones, gentle highlight rolloff, fine grain, slightly lifted shadows
bricks.when: For a person in natural light that should feel close and kind.

explanation.en: Colour negative film made for faces: warm, soft, forgiving.
explanation.ru: Цветная негативная плёнка для лиц: тёплая, мягкая, прощающая.

bricks.description: high-contrast black and white film pushed two stops, coarse visible grain, deep blacks, gritty street-photo texture
bricks.when: For a raw, urgent picture; not for a gentle song.

explanation.en: Black-and-white film developed for more contrast than it was made for.
explanation.ru: Чёрно-белая плёнка, проявленная контрастнее, чем рассчитана.

bricks.description: expired colour film, shifted colours toward magenta and teal, uneven density, light leaks at the edge of the frame, soft focus
bricks.when: For memory, nostalgia, a picture that seems found in a drawer.

explanation.en: Old film past its date: colours drift and edges glow.
explanation.ru: Старая плёнка после срока: цвета плывут, края засвечены.

bricks.description: cross-processed slide film, strong yellow-green highlights, cyan shadows, punchy contrast, oversaturated
bricks.when: For an electric, summer, slightly wrong picture.

explanation.en: Slide film developed in the chemistry for negatives.
explanation.ru: Слайдовая плёнка, проявленная в химии для негатива.

bricks.description: vintage colour slide film, deep saturated reds and blues, crisp detail, dark rich shadows, mid-century colour palette
bricks.when: For a bold, classic, colourful picture.

explanation.en: Colour reversal film known for its reds.
